programs.title: Hollywood On Set 23
programs.desc: The program takes viewers behind the scenes of film production.In each episode, the creators discuss three cinema hits.They show how spectacular effects, impressive sets and acting performances are created.

programs.title: DJ Ahmet
programs.desc: In the Macedonian village of Yuruk, the inhabitants live in accordance with tradition.Young people quickly start families and go on their own.15-year-old Ahmet (Arif Jakup) usually looks after sheep and takes care of his younger brother, but he loves electronic music and would like to become a DJ.To the dismay of his father and the conservative community, he equips his tractor with a sound system.His path crosses with a fellow dancer, Aya, who also dreams of a different life.The girl will soon get married according to her parents' decision.Together they decide to organize a party - as a rebellious act of freedom and self-expression.The feature debut of a creator from North Macedonia, who turned out to be one of the winners of Sundance in 2025.It's a touching story about growing up in a place where techno and tradition do not go hand in hand.

programs.title: The Other Guys
programs.desc: Hot-tempered New York detective Terry Hoitz (Mark Wahlberg) dreams of his name going down in police history.Unfortunately, he is punitively delegated to office work.His dim-witted partner Allen Gamble (Will Ferrell) is not keen on catching criminals and would rather spend his days behind a desk.As a result, those with completely opposite characters do not like each other.However, both of them share a feeling of inferiority because they are still in the shadow of the local police celebrities: P.K.Highsmith (Samuel L. Jackson) and Christopher Danson (Dwayne Johnson).The opportunity to take their place comes sooner than they might expect.When the famous duo is killed in action, Terry and Allen face the opportunity of a lifetime.They are on the trail of a scandal involving multimillionaire David Ershon (Steve Coogan).If they manage to find evidence of a crime and catch the culprits, they will gain recognition and decorations.However, if they fail, they will face professional degradation.

programs.title: Across the Universe
programs.desc: 1960s.Young Briton Jude (Jim Sturgess) goes to the United States in search of his father, whom he has never known before.The man is said to be a university lecturer.However, he turns out to be an ordinary worker.There, Jude meets a teenage American girl, Lucy (Evan Rachel Wood).They both fall in love with each other at first sight.Soon, Lucy's brother, Max (Joe Anderson), is drafted and goes to war in Vietnam.Meanwhile, Jude and Lucy, along with a group of friends and musicians, engage in anti-war activities.Their guides are: Dr. Robert (Bono) and Mr. Kite (Eddie Izzard).Together they fight for freedom of speech and civil rights.However, the tense situation is not favorable for lovers.Adversity tears them apart.They have to overcome many obstacles to be together again.The film's soundtrack included several songs by the legendary band The Beatles.The film was nominated for a Golden Globe (Best Musical) and an Oscar (Best Costume Design).

programs.title: I.S.S
programs.desc: There are American and Russian astronauts on the International Space Station.The US team consists of Dr. Kira Foster (Ariana DeBose), who recently joined the team, officer Christian Campbell (John Gallagher Jr.) and the mission commander Gordon Barrett (Chris Messina).On a daily basis, they cooperate with the second group, which includes Weronika Vetrow (Masha Mashkova), Nikolaj Pulov (Costa Ronin) and his brother Alexei (Pilou Asbaek).Despite political and cultural differences, the astronauts get along great.There is a friendly atmosphere at the station, and Gordon and Weronika, who have started an affair, have something more in common.Everything changes when the six of them notice a terrifying phenomenon on Earth.Everyone watches with growing horror as a wave of fire spreads on the surface of the planet, where their homes and loved ones are located.This can only mean one thing - the outbreak of nuclear war.The situation escalates when Barrett learns that Russia has attacked the United States and receives an order from the US government to take control of the station.Together with Christian and Kira, they suspect that their colleagues received a similar task.Additionally, they discover that the station is currently orbiting too low.It will fall to Earth if help does not arrive within 24 hours.A fight for survival begins, and the former friends now turn on each other.

programs.title: Abigail
programs.desc: A group of criminals breaks into a perfectly secured mansion.Their goal is to kidnap twelve-year-old ballerina Abigail (Alisha Weir).The bandits transport a hostage, for whom a ransom of $50 million has been set, to Lambert (Giancarlo Esposito).She is to spend the night in an isolated residence.The kidnappers guarding her disappear one by one.The truth about who they were locked up with finally comes to light.The inconspicuous-looking victim is not as defenseless as it may seem.An unusual variation on the vampire motif.

programs.title: The Lighthouse
programs.desc: 1890s.A remote island off the coast of Maine.The lighthouse is guarded by two men.Thomas Wake (Willem Dafoe) is old, stubborn and struggling with a painful leg injury.The younger of them, Thomas Howard (Robert Pattinson), initially seems a bit more open due to his age.However, he hides a secret that made him choose to work in isolation.What they have in common is that they are twisted by life.They will have to spend four arduous weeks in each other's company.Over time, isolation from the world and weather conditions take their toll on them.Both lighthouse keepers are slowly losing their sanity.The director of this psychological horror film, which has received many awards and nominations, is Robert Eggers, the creator of the acclaimed film "The Witch: A New England Folk Tale".Jarin Blashke received Oscar and BAFTA nominations for best cinematography.

programs.title: Baby Driver
programs.desc: Atlanta.Baby lost his parents in an accident.He himself suffered serious injuries.The boy became involved in cooperation with criminals after he tried to steal a car belonging to the cunning Doc.Since then, he has been in the gangster's employ.His task is seemingly simple - he is to take the team of thieves away from the scene of the robbery as quickly as possible.One day, the boy meets his dream girl - Deborah.He knows perfectly well that there is no place for feelings in illegal business.So he decides to break away from the underworld and start a normal life.However, it turns out that it will not be easy.The boss is not going to let a valuable driver go.She blackmails him into participating in another daring robbery.Not everything goes according to plan.

programs.title: River Wild
programs.desc: Idaho.Doctor Joey (Leighton Meester) goes to meet Brother Gray (Taran Killam), who is organizing a rafting trip on the Salmon River.There he meets his long-time friend Trevor (Adam Brody), who is on parole, and two young women.Initially, the rafting takes place in a relaxed atmosphere.Everything changes on their first night together, when the kayakers set up camp.One of the young women suffers serious injuries.The circumstances of the incident are unclear, and the injured party herself claims that she was the victim of an attack.The incident disturbs the peace of Joey and the other participants of the expedition.However, it turns out that this is only the beginning of the problems.

programs.title: Queen Of Bones
programs.desc: 1930s.Teenage twins Lillian (Julia Butters) and Samuel (Jacob Tremblay) live in rural Oregon.They are half-orphans because their mother died during childbirth.The father, religious fanatic Malcolm (Martin Freeman), treats his children harshly.Ida (Taylor Schilling), who may become the teenagers' stepmother in the future, also shows no sympathy for them.Meanwhile, one day, Lillian and Samuel find a book of pagan spells in their mother's trunk.They come to the conclusion that using them will help them free themselves from the influence of adults and gain power not only over their lives, but also their surroundings.

programs.title: Killing the Competition
programs.desc: Bossy Elizabeth Fenwick (Melissa Joan Hart) was once the star of the cheerleading squad.Currently, the woman is very keen for her teenage daughter, Grace (Lily Brooks O'Briant), to follow in her footsteps.Unfortunately, although the girl performs very well in the team selection committee, other candidates turn out to be better and she is rejected.Elizabeth can't come to terms with it.Unable to forgive his daughter for this failure, he begins to harass her, lowering her self-esteem.Gradually, the woman's actions take the form of obsession.Finally, to ensure Grace's place in the band, she decides to expel another student from her high school, an excellent dancer named Hannah (Valerie Loo).To do this, he intends to kidnap the girl and her mother, Nicole (Anzu Lawson).Inspired by true events, the film tells the story of the obsession that a parent's unfulfilled ambition can turn into.

programs.title: Trolls World Tour
programs.desc: Poppy lives a peaceful life in her colorful and singing kingdom.One day he learns that beyond his borders there are other lands inhabited by trolls.Each of them has different rhythms.Just as she loves pop, the creatures inhabiting distant lands prefer rock, funk, techno, country and classical music.The curious queen, together with Mruk and other friends, sets off on a journey to meet and unite her kin.She will have to face the rebellious Barb, who wants to ensure that only rock rules in all lands.The continuation of the 2016 hit sticks to a proven recipe for success - a joyful, extremely colorful animation packed with great hits, showing the unifying power of music and the need for tolerance.The pandemic made the film go down in cinema history as the first high-budget production that went straight to VOD services, without a cinema premiere.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Magdalena Wasylik (Poppy), Piotr Bajtlik (Mruk) and Monika Węgiel-Jarocińska (Barb).
